g.text: Deployment view — zones, workloads, and the policies that enforce them
If the broker crossed the boundary to reach
the store, the credential would cross back the
other way and the design is defeated. Moving
the broker is not sufficient on its own.
operators connect from outside the cluster
the only in-cluster egress is to monitor-zone
— it shares a host with the secret store, so an IP rule would open both. Name-based keeps gateway → store denied
nothing but the identity zone may reach it
the broker is reachable only via the monitor
egress limited to DNS, the secret store, and the target
